create or replace function private.srk_get_customer_call_contacts_impl()
returns table(booking_id uuid, booking_status text, electrician_name text, electrician_phone text)
language plpgsql
stable
security definer
set search_path to 'public', 'pg_temp'
as $function$
declare
  v_uid uuid := auth.uid();
begin
  if v_uid is null then
    raise exception 'Authentication required';
  end if;

  -- Keep real phone numbers private until OTP-verified masked calling is integrated.
  return query
  select b.id, b.status, ep.display_name, null::text
  from public.service_bookings b
  join public.electrician_profiles ep on ep.id = b.assigned_electrician_id
  where b.customer_user_id = v_uid
    and b.assigned_electrician_id is not null
    and b.status in ('assigned','inspection','awaiting_quote_approval','quote_approved','in_progress');
end;
$function$;

create or replace function public.srk_get_my_offer_details()
returns table(
  offer_id uuid,
  offer_status text,
  match_level text,
  offer_created_at timestamptz,
  booking_id uuid,
  service_type text,
  state text,
  district text,
  pincode text,
  preferred_date date,
  preferred_time time without time zone,
  work_details text,
  quoted_amount numeric,
  booking_status text,
  customer_name text,
  customer_phone text,
  address text,
  location_lat double precision,
  location_lng double precision,
  service_charge numeric,
  materials_amount numeric,
  quote_status text,
  quote_note text
)
language sql
stable
security definer
set search_path to 'pg_catalog', 'public', 'auth', 'pg_temp'
as $function$
 select o.id,o.status,o.match_level,o.created_at,b.id,b.service_type,b.state,b.district,b.pincode,
 b.preferred_date,b.preferred_time,b.work_details,b.quoted_amount,b.status,
 case when b.assigned_electrician_id=p.id then b.customer_name else null end,
 null::text,
 case when b.assigned_electrician_id=p.id then b.address else null end,
 case when b.assigned_electrician_id=p.id then b.location_lat else null end,
 case when b.assigned_electrician_id=p.id then b.location_lng else null end,
 case when b.assigned_electrician_id=p.id then b.service_charge else null end,
 case when b.assigned_electrician_id=p.id then b.materials_amount else null end,
 case when b.assigned_electrician_id=p.id then b.quote_status else null end,
 case when b.assigned_electrician_id=p.id then b.quote_note else null end
 from public.job_offers o
 join public.electrician_profiles p on p.id=o.electrician_id
 join public.service_bookings b on b.id=o.booking_id
 where p.user_id=auth.uid() and p.verification_status='approved' and p.active=true
 order by o.created_at desc limit 100;
$function$;

rows.name: customer_contact_after_completion
statements:
-- SRK ELECTRONIC: keep reciprocal phone visibility after a booking is completed.
-- Apply only after Supabase migration history has been reconciled and this
-- function replacement has been reviewed in the target project.
CREATE OR REPLACE FUNCTION private.srk_get_customer_call_contacts_impl()
RETURNS TABLE(
  booking_id uuid,
  booking_status text,
  electrician_name text,
  electrician_phone text
)
LANGUAGE plpgsql
STABLE
SECURITY DEFINER
SET search_path TO 'pg_catalog', 'public', 'auth', 'pg_temp'
AS $function$
DECLARE
  v_uid uuid := auth.uid();
BEGIN
  IF v_uid IS NULL THEN
    RAISE EXCEPTION 'Authentication required';
  END IF;

  RETURN QUERY
  SELECT b.id, b.status, ep.display_name, ep.phone
  FROM public.service_bookings b
  JOIN public.electrician_profiles ep
    ON ep.id = b.assigned_electrician_id
  WHERE b.customer_user_id = v_uid
    AND b.assigned_electrician_id IS NOT NULL
    AND b.status IN (
      'assigned',
      'inspection',
      'awaiting_quote_approval',
      'quote_approved',
      'in_progress',
      'completed'
    );
END;
$function$;

-- Keep electrician offer rows visible, but expose customer contact/location/quote details
-- only while the booking is actively assigned through completion.

create or replace function public.srk_get_my_offer_details()
returns table(
  offer_id uuid,
  offer_status text,
  match_level text,
  offer_created_at timestamptz,
  booking_id uuid,
  service_type text,
  state text,
  district text,
  pincode text,
  preferred_date date,
  preferred_time time without time zone,
  work_details text,
  quoted_amount numeric,
  booking_status text,
  customer_name text,
  customer_phone text,
  address text,
  location_lat double precision,
  location_lng double precision,
  service_charge numeric,
  materials_amount numeric,
  quote_status text,
  quote_note text
)
language sql
stable
security definer
set search_path = pg_catalog, public, auth, pg_temp
as $function$
  select
    o.id,
    o.status,
    o.match_level,
    o.created_at,
    b.id,
    b.service_type,
    b.state,
    b.district,
    b.pincode,
    b.preferred_date,
    b.preferred_time,
    b.work_details,
    b.quoted_amount,
    b.status,
    case
      when b.assigned_electrician_id = p.id
       and b.status in ('assigned','inspection','awaiting_quote_approval','quote_approved','in_progress','completed')
      then b.customer_name else null
    end,
    case
      when b.assigned_electrician_id = p.id
       and b.status in ('assigned','inspection','awaiting_quote_approval','quote_approved','in_progress','completed')
      then b.phone else null
    end,
    case
      when b.assigned_electrician_id = p.id
       and b.status in ('assigned','inspection','awaiting_quote_approval','quote_approved','in_progress','completed')
      then b.address else null
    end,
    case
      when b.assigned_electrician_id = p.id
       and b.status in ('assigned','inspection','awaiting_quote_approval','quote_approved','in_progress','completed')
      then b.location_lat else null
    end,
    case
      when b.assigned_electrician_id = p.id
       and b.status in ('assigned','inspection','awaiting_quote_approval','quote_approved','in_progress','completed')
      then b.location_lng else null
    end,
    case
      when b.assigned_electrician_id = p.id
       and b.status in ('assigned','inspection','awaiting_quote_approval','quote_approved','in_progress','completed')
      then b.service_charge else null
    end,
    case
      when b.assigned_electrician_id = p.id
       and b.status in ('assigned','inspection','awaiting_quote_approval','quote_approved','in_progress','completed')
      then b.materials_amount else null
    end,
    case
      when b.assigned_electrician_id = p.id
       and b.status in ('assigned','inspection','awaiting_quote_approval','quote_approved','in_progress','completed')
      then b.quote_status else null
    end,
    case
      when b.assigned_electrician_id = p.id
       and b.status in ('assigned','inspection','awaiting_quote_approval','quote_approved','in_progress','completed')
      then b.quote_note else null
    end
  from public.job_offers o
  join public.electrician_profiles p on p.id = o.electrician_id
  join public.service_bookings b on b.id = o.booking_id
  where p.user_id = auth.uid()
    and p.verification_status = 'approved'
    and p.active = true
  order by o.created_at desc
  limit 100;
$function$;

statements:
-- Keep the electrician profile identity columns synchronized and align job-offer RLS
-- with the canonical user_id used by the electrician portal and its SECURITY DEFINER RPCs.
CREATE OR REPLACE FUNCTION public.srk_link_electrician_profile()
RETURNS trigger
LANGUAGE plpgsql
SECURITY DEFINER
SET search_path TO 'pg_catalog', 'public', 'auth', 'pg_temp'
AS $function$
BEGIN
  IF NEW.phone IS NOT NULL AND NEW.phone_confirmed_at IS NOT NULL THEN
    UPDATE public.electrician_profiles
       SET user_id = NEW.id,
           auth_user_id = NEW.id
     WHERE right(pg_catalog.regexp_replace(phone, '[^0-9]', '', 'g'), 10) =
           right(pg_catalog.regexp_replace(NEW.phone, '[^0-9]', '', 'g'), 10)
       AND verification_status = 'approved'
       AND user_id IS NULL;
  END IF;
  RETURN NEW;
END;
$function$;

DROP POLICY IF EXISTS electrician_and_admin_read_offers ON public.job_offers;
CREATE POLICY electrician_and_admin_read_offers
ON public.job_offers
FOR SELECT
TO authenticated
USING (
  (SELECT public.is_srk_admin())
  OR EXISTS (
    SELECT 1
      FROM public.electrician_profiles e
     WHERE e.id = job_offers.electrician_id
       AND (e.user_id = (SELECT auth.uid()) OR e.auth_user_id = (SELECT auth.uid()))
       AND e.active = true
       AND e.verification_status = 'approved'
  )
);
